# Eggwall

> A personal blog and portfolio by Vikram Aggarwal featuring technical documentation, book reviews, and essays on labor, parenting, and systems engineering.

Eggwall is maintained by Vikram Aggarwal, a Google engineer specializing in Linux systems and performance optimization, alongside profiles of collaborators like Neha Pandey. The site blends technical tutorials with cultural criticism and personal reflection.

## Key Topics

- Vikram Aggarwal
- Linux systems
- Book reviews
- Labor conditions
- Python
- Git/GitHub
- Amazon fulfillment
- Systems performance
- BPF tools
- Wage workers
- Workplace burnout
- Parenting culture
- Software engineering
- Capitalism critique
- Technical documentation

## Profiles & About

- [Vikram Aggarwal](https://www.eggwall.com): Homepage featuring Vikram Aggarwal's book review of 'On The Clock'

- [Neha Pandey: Profile](https://www.eggwall.com/p/neha.html): Profile of Neha Pandey with education and career background

## Book Reviews & Essays

- [Book Review: "On The Clock" by Emily Guendelsberger](https://www.eggwall.com/2024/07/book-review-on-clock-by-emily.html): Book review of 'On The Clock' examining Amazon and McDonald's labor practices and wage worker conditions
- [Book Review: Systems Performance 2nd ed, by Brendan Gregg](https://www.eggwall.com/2022/02/book-review-systems-performance-2nd-ed.html): Review of 'Systems Performance' covering Linux tuning and BPF tools for performance analysis
- [The Oversubscribed American Child](https://www.eggwall.com/2024/07/the-oversubscribed-american-child.html): Essay on parenting culture and oversubscribed children in Bay Area
- [Christone "Kingfish" Ingram](https://www.eggwall.com/2022/02/christone-kingfish-ingram.html): Music review of blues guitarist Christone 'Kingfish' Ingram

## Technical Tutorials & Documentation

- [Encrypted, Private GitHub Repositories](https://www.eggwall.com/2024/06/encrypted-private-github-repositories.html): Tutorial on encrypting private GitHub repos using GnuPG and git
- [Python, pip, venv, Package Managers](https://www.eggwall.com/2022/08/python-pip-venv-package-managers.html): Guide to Python package management with pip and venv
